provenance.method: offline rigid-body GraspNet->EEF calibration with end-to-end physical canary
provenance.eef_frame_note: OpenETA EEF pos = gripper0_grip_site position; EEF quat = robot0_right_hand body orientation (mixed frame). T_grasp_eef assembled against this exact convention.
provenance.approach_axis: +X column of the GraspNet rotation is the approach direction; translation origin is grasp translation_xyz (depth-independent).

candidate_status.reason: Candidate status is retained until exact model-terminal contact, native attachment, and exact model-goal release validation pass on held-out scenes.
candidate_status.not_validated_because: The rigid frame/TCP transform has not yet met the current end-to-end native contact/attachment/release gates.
candidate_status.gates_unchanged: Frame/TCP fit and held-out exact-terminal task success must pass without host pose offsets.
candidate_status.intended_use: GraspNet-frame to Panda EEF representation conversion only; it must not generate task-family pose offsets.
